name: facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/a.make_atari_env: create an Atari environment with NoopResetEnv and MaxAndSkipEnv wrappers using make_atari
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/a.wrap_deepmind_env: wrap an Atari environment with DeepMind-style preprocessing including frame stacking and reward clipping
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/a.wrap_pytorch_env: wrap an environment to transpose image observations from HWC to CHW format for PyTorch

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/a.use_WarpFrame_wrapper: warp environment frames to 84x84 grayscale using the WarpFrame observation wrapper

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/m.train_atari_agent: train a PPO agent on an Atari environment using multiple actors and learner threads
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/m.test_atari_agent: test a trained Atari agent by running episodes and logging average returns
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/m.create_atari_net: create a convolutional neural network with optional LSTM for Atari frame-based RL
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/m.compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the policy gradient loss from logits, actions, and advantages
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/m.create_env: create a DeepMind-wrapped Atari gym environment with frame stacking and PyTorch tensors

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.run_polybeast_cli: run the polybeast reinforcement learning agent with learner and environment processes via CLI
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.run_env_function: run the polybeast environment process with a given actor id and flags in a forked process
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.run_learner_function: run the polybeast learner process with parsed command line flags in the main process
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.review_main_function: review the main function that parses args and spawns multiprocessing environment and learner processes
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.summarize_polybeast_entry: summarize the polybeast entry point that coordinates learner and environment via multiprocessing

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.run_polybeast_env_server: run the polybeast environment server with multiple Atari environment processes using unix pipes
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.create_env_atari: create a wrapped Atari environment using DeepMind wrappers with frame stacking and PyTorch formatting
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.serve_environment: serve an Atari or Mock environment over a libtorchbeast server at a given address
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.review_Env_class: review the Env mock class that provides reset and step methods returning numpy arrays
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.refactor_main_multiprocessing: refactor the main function to spawn multiple daemon processes for parallel environment serving

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.train_polybeast_agent: train a PolyBeast RL agent using the PyTorch Scalable Agent with configurable actors and learning steps
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.run_net_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the Net model to get action, policy logits, and baseline outputs
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the policy gradient loss using target policy logits, actions, and advantages
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.compute_entropy_loss: compute the entropy loss as the negative entropy of the policy from logits
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/p.compute_baseline_loss: compute the baseline loss as half the sum of squared advantages
